en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2140 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:

"There is no one who raises their voice in Talbiyah (Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik) except that everything to their right up to the ends of the earth and everything to their left up to the ends of the earth also proclaims the Talbiyah. Then the two angels say to them: 'Rejoice, O servant of Allah (swt)!' And Allah (swt) does not give glad tidings to a servant except with Paradise."
